answer.says: Good evening, gentlemen. I have eaten my fill of your samosas and your words. The evening air is cooling, and I must walk. I will be at Lodhi Gardens; if the file returns tomorrow, I shall be there to receive its verdict, or to await the next delay.
answer.thought: The file is gone for orders, a suspension that mirrors the state of my own residence: I am here, yet not yet recognized as such. I must move to Lodhi Gardens as planned, to let the mind settle before the talk on Tuesday. The air is clear, a rare mercy in this city of dust.
